title: AEGS Evidence Record
description:
One tamper-evident entry in an append-only log. Distinct from a GovernanceDecision: the decision is *what was decided*, the evidence record is *the artefact proving it was decided then and has not changed since*.

KNOWN LIMIT OF HASH CHAINING, stated in the schema because implementers must know it: any prefix of a valid chain is itself a valid chain. Editing an entry is detectable and deleting a middle entry is detectable, but **truncating the tail is not**. An implementation claiming tamper-evidence needs an external anchor -- `anchor` below -- or it can only detect edits, not erasure.

previousHash.description: Null only for the genesis entry.

subjectId.description: The decision, authorization or incident this entry concerns.

anchor.description: An external commitment the log itself cannot rewrite. WITHOUT THIS, TRUNCATION IS UNDETECTABLE. A head pointer stored beside the log does not count -- whoever can truncate the log can edit the file next to it.
